starter:
-- Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024 revenue by channel. Write it from scratch.
-- Definitions: Q4 = 1 Oct to 31 Dec (half-open ranges), revenue = item revenue,
-- every status except 'cancelled'.
-- Output: channel, revenue_q4_2024, revenue_q4_2025, growth_pct
SELECT channel
FROM orders
GROUP BY channel;
solution:
WITH order_revenue AS (
  -- grain: one row per order
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS revenue
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
q4_orders AS (
  -- grain: one row per non-cancelled Q4 order
  SELECT
    o.channel,
    CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN 'Q4 2024' ELSE 'Q4 2025' END AS period,
    r.revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_revenue AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01')
      OR (o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01')
    )
)
SELECT
  channel,
  ROUND(SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE period = 'Q4 2024'), 2) AS revenue_q4_2024,
  ROUND(SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE period = 'Q4 2025'), 2) AS revenue_q4_2025,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE period = 'Q4 2025')
               - SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE period = 'Q4 2024'))
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE period = 'Q4 2024'), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q4_orders
GROUP BY channel;
